SELECT quota.storage_quota_id, quota.user_id, quota.user_code, quota.bucket_name, quota.storage_type, quota.base_quota_bytes, quota.addon_quota_bytes, quota.total_quota_bytes, quota.used_bytes, quota.reserved_bytes, quota.usage_status, quota.provision_status, quota.quota_sync_status, quota.create_time, quota.update_time, latest_recycle.recycle_id AS latest_recycle_id, latest_recycle.recycle_status AS latest_recycle_status, latest_recycle.started_time AS recycle_created_time, latest_recycle.retention_until AS recycle_expired_time, COALESCE(valid_recycle.valid_recycle_count, 0) AS valid_recycle_count, EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM byai.po_user_storage_grant history_grant WHERE history_grant.user_id = quota.user_id ) AS has_grant_history, ( quota.usage_status = 'EXCEEDED' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM byai.po_user_storage_grant first_grant WHERE first_grant.user_id = quota.user_id ) ) AS first_quota_limit FROM byai.po_user_storage_quota quota LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ranked.recycle_id, ranked.user_id, ranked.recycle_status, ranked.started_time, ranked.retention_until FROM ( SELECT recycle.recycle_id, recycle.user_id, recycle.recycle_status, recycle.started_time, recycle.retention_until, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY recycle.user_id ORDER BY recycle.started_time DESC NULLS LAST, recycle.recycle_id DESC ) AS row_number FROM byai.po_user_storage_recycle recycle ) ranked WHERE ranked.row_number = 1 ) latest_recycle ON latest_recycle.user_id = quota.user_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT recycle.user_id, COUNT(*) AS valid_recycle_count FROM byai.po_user_storage_recycle recycle WHERE recycle.recycle_status = 'AVAILABLE' AND recycle.retention_until > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP GROUP BY recycle.user_id ) valid_recycle ON valid_recycle.user_id = quota.user_id
quota.delete_flag = '0'
AND quota.user_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.userCode}, '%')
AND ( quota.user_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR quota.bucket_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') )
AND quota.usage_status = #{query.usageStatus}
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM byai.po_user_storage_grant active_grant WHERE active_grant.user_id = quota.user_id AND active_grant.package_id = #{query.packageId} AND active_grant.grant_status = 'ACTIVE' )
AND valid_recycle.valid_recycle_count > 0
AND latest_recycle.started_time >= #{query.recycleCreatedStart}
AND latest_recycle.started_time <= #{query.recycleCreatedEnd}
AND latest_recycle.retention_until >= #{query.recycleExpiredStart}
AND latest_recycle.retention_until <= #{query.recycleExpiredEnd}
ORDER BY
quota.used_bytes
CASE quota.usage_status WHEN 'NORMAL' THEN 1 WHEN 'WARNING' THEN 2 WHEN 'EXCEEDED' THEN 3 WHEN 'RESETTING' THEN 4 WHEN 'RESTORING' THEN 5 ELSE 99 END
latest_recycle.started_time
latest_recycle.retention_until
quota.update_time
ASC DESC
NULLS LAST, quota.storage_quota_id DESC
